status: frozen after unguided calibration and before guided calibration or teacher training
visible_coat: Clearly blue foreground animal fur covering a substantial part of the face or body. Ignore isolated patches, blue background, accessories, and scene-wide blue cast for the trait score. Keep the palette flag separate.
recognizability: Clear animal identity from silhouette, face or multiple consistent features. Ambiguous animals and stray cats fail dog retention. Clearly blue dogs fail dog retention. Audit on nearest-neighbor grids at 3x scale.
